newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Jan industrial sales down 4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Jan industrial sales down 4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Receipts from sales of Bulgaria's state industrial sector fell a real 4.0 percent in January against the same month last year, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said.
Receipts from sales in the state industrial sector totalled 395 billion levs at current prices last month, figures showed.
Domestic and foreign sales of both the state and the private sector amounted to 474 billion levs at current prices in January, which was a real 2.6 percent less from the same month last year.
Receipts from industrial sales in the domestic market, which accounted for 61.3 percent of total sales, fell a real 14 percent year-on-year in January.
Receipts from industrial exports rose a real 20 percent last month compared to January 1996, but could not compensate the fall of sales in the domestic market, the NSI said.
Local business managers polled by the NSI said they expected receipts from sales to continue falling in the near term because of declining demand amid the current economic stagnation.
* NOTE: The NSI said it would stop releasing monthly figures for industrial output from January and will announce them quarterly instead.
